app: the CloudScale demo app (Next.js, source in app/app/)

objectives.title: Desktop: primary CTA receives the click (UC-01, UC-02)
objectives.objective: Open {{url}}/app. Verify the heading contains "CloudScale AI Inference Gateway" and Active keys reads "2 Keys". Click the button "Generate Production API Key" with a mouse click, as a user would. Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers the button; if the click does not reach it, the check fails. Verify Action status displays "KEY_GENERATED_HEALTHY" and Active keys reads "3 Keys".

objectives.title: Narrow screen, mobile layout: quota top-up stays reachable (UC-03)
objectives.objective: Open {{url}}/app. Verify Available quota reads "$4,500.00". Click "+ Top Up Quota ($250)" with a mouse click, as a user would. Do not use the keyboard, and do not wait for or work around anything that covers it; if the click does not reach it, the check fails. Verify Available quota reads "$4,750.00" and Action status displays "QUOTA_TOPUP_SUCCESS".
